issues: First-level sheet cards retain manual effects. Maintained-state effects, target validation and conditional combat bonuses are not automatically applied.
Index and individual page disagree for Elemental Threnody; individual Duration field is used.
First-level data does not establish coverage of the 135 level-2–6 songs.

entries.name: Adoration
entries.mechanicsSummary: Outside combat, the target gains +2 morale on Diplomacy checks to influence creatures. In performance combat, it instead gains +2 morale on performance combat checks.

entries.name: Alter Musical Instrument
entries.mechanicsSummary: Make a familiar instrument sound like another familiar instrument. Volume, pitch range, playing method and all other properties stay unchanged.

entries.name: Amplify

targeting.area: 20-ft.-radius emanation centered on a creature, object, or point in space

entries.mechanicsSummary: Decrease hearing DCs for sounds within the emanation by 20. Creatures inside do not notice the amplification. The area can move with a creature; an unwilling creature receives a Will save and spell resistance. Attended objects use their owner’s defenses; unattended objects and points in space do not.

entries.name: Army’s Paeon
entries.mechanicsSummary: Affected nearby allies gain fast healing 2 each round while the song is maintained, within its range and duration.

entries.name: Clarion Call
entries.mechanicsSummary: The touched creature can mime a horn or trumpet blast and speak with a booming voice. Decrease the DC to hear its speech by 15.

entries.name: Distort Speech
entries.mechanicsSummary: Warp the target’s voice into incomprehensible sounds. It suffers 50% spell failure when casting spells with a vocal component.

entries.name: Elemental Carol
entries.mechanicsSummary: Choose dark, earth, fire, ice, light, lightning, water or wind. While maintained, allies in range gain +2 morale to saves against the chosen element’s spells and effects, and resistance 5 to that element.

entries.name: Elemental Threnody
entries.mechanicsSummary: Choose dark, earth, fire, ice, light, lightning, water or wind. While maintained, enemies in range take a −2 penalty on saves against the chosen element’s spells and effects, and their resistance to that element is reduced by 5.

entries.name: Fear Filled Tune

targeting.target: one living creature with 5 or fewer HD

entries.mechanicsSummary: A living target with at most 5 HD becomes frightened for 1d4 rounds. A successful Will save instead leaves it shaken for 1 round. Frightened creatures flee if possible, use abilities needed to escape, and take −2 on attacks, saves, skills and ability checks; they may fight if unable to flee.

entries.name: Feather Bar

targeting.target: 1 object of up to 1 cubic ft./level

entries.mechanicsSummary: Halve the object’s weight. If the object is armor, reduce its armor check penalty by 1 without changing its light, medium or heavy category.

entries.name: Focusing Chant
entries.mechanicsSummary: Gain +1 circumstance on attack rolls, skill checks and ability checks for the song’s duration.

entries.name: Foe Requiem
entries.mechanicsSummary: Each round, one targeted creature takes non-elemental damage equal to the bard’s Charisma modifier. Only one Foe Requiem/Discord song may be in effect.

entries.name: Fortuitous Beat
entries.mechanicsSummary: Nearby allies gain +2 morale on Fortitude saves while the song is maintained.

entries.name: Hideous Laughter
entries.mechanicsSummary: The target falls prone laughing and cannot act, but is not helpless. On its next turn it may spend a non-provoking full-round action for one additional save; success ends the effect, failure leaves it laughing for the remaining duration. Intelligence 2 or less is immune. A different creature type from the bard gains +4 on the save.

entries.name: Insidious Rhythm
entries.mechanicsSummary: The target takes −4 on Intelligence-based skills and Concentration checks. Each attempt to cast, concentrate on or direct a spell requires a Concentration check against this song’s save DC plus that spell’s level, or the attempt fails.

entries.name: Inspirational Boost

targeting.target: allies affected by your Inspire Courage bardic performance

entries.mechanicsSummary: Increase the bonuses of Inspire Courage by 1. End when the song or Inspire Courage ends, whichever happens first. If Inspire Courage is not begun before the start of the next turn, this song ends.

entries.name: Joyful Noise
entries.mechanicsSummary: Magical silencing effects within the emanation are suppressed, letting allies ignore Silenced while inside. Those effects keep counting down and resume outside the area; they are not dispelled.

entries.name: Knight’s Minne
entries.mechanicsSummary: Nearby allies gain +2 deflection to AC while the song is maintained.

entries.name: Lion’s Song

targeting.targets: one creature plus one additional creature per four levels, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

entries.mechanicsSummary: Grant targets +4 morale against fear for 10 minutes and suppress any fear effect already affecting them for that duration. Suppression does not remove the original fear effect.

entries.name: Performer's Wine

targeting.target: 1 cu. ft./2 levels of liquid (see text)

entries.mechanicsSummary: Turn nonmagical liquids, even contaminated ones, into average mead or wine. Spoils unholy water and similar significant liquids, but does not affect creatures, magic potions or alchemical items, nor prevent later spoilage. Drinkers gain +2 enhancement on Intelligence- and Wisdom-based skill checks; this becomes +5 at caster level 9 and +10 at 15.

entries.name: Play Instrument
entries.mechanicsSummary: Play one chosen instrument, including an improvised object, as if you had 1 rank in its associated Perform skill. This is temporary and does not grant a permanent skill rank.

entries.name: Quick Etude
entries.mechanicsSummary: Nearby allies gain +2 dodge to AC against ranged attacks while the song is maintained.

entries.name: Reflexive Strum
entries.mechanicsSummary: Nearby allies gain +2 morale on Reflex saves while the song is maintained.

entries.name: Resonance Armor
entries.mechanicsSummary: Gain +4 armor to AC without armor check penalty, spell failure or speed reduction. Sound-based attacks, including qualifying bells and Musical Power, do not bypass this AC bonus. Also gain +2 circumstance on saves against sonic effects.

entries.name: Saving Finale
entries.savingThrow: with a bonus equal to the level of the song you ended – 1 (ex: ending a 2nd level song gives a saving throw bonus of +1).
entries.mechanicsSummary: When a creature fails a save, immediately end one maintained song of level 1 or higher to let it reroll. Its reroll bonus equals the ended song’s level minus 1; ending a level-1 song gives +0. A jingle does not qualify.

entries.name: Sheepfoe Mambo
entries.mechanicsSummary: Nearby allies gain +1 morale on saving throws while the song is maintained.

entries.name: Solid Note
entries.mechanicsSummary: Create a hand-sized immovable musical note usable as a hook, pulley or obstruction. Strength is 10 + caster level; weight over its heavy load or a successful opposed Strength check makes it disappear. It deals no harm and vanishes on a successful attack (AC 10 + Charisma modifier) or combat maneuver (CMD 2 + BAB + Charisma modifier). Failing to move the note wastes that action.

entries.name: Suit of the Dancer
entries.mechanicsSummary: Exchange worn clothing with one outfit in the bard’s Attire Space, or retrieve an outfit folded beside the bard. Storing each outfit costs a separate performance of the song. Capacity is 10 pounds per caster level. Armor and wondrous items are excluded unless counted as clothing. Stored or exchanged clothes are magically cleaned.

entries.name: Toilsome Chant
entries.mechanicsSummary: Perform as part of starting Inspire Competence. Its benefit lasts through the target’s next check with the chosen skill, however long that task takes, even after the bardic performance ends. This does not grant Inspire Competence to a bard who lacks it.

entries.name: Willful Clash
entries.mechanicsSummary: Nearby allies gain +2 morale on Will saves while the song is maintained.
